title: Enterprise Connectivity: tax source identity
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity applies this tax source identity rule to separate statutory tax.

## Basis: selected assessment
For separate statutory tax, select the latest source classification primary invoice assessment on this holding by occurrence time; its latest timestamp must be unique, and use that exact review identifier throughout the assisted invoice cycle.

## Basis: selected export bundle
For separate statutory tax, read source-event reference from the exact selected invoice assessment to identify the original selected export bundle; an unrelated historical assessment cannot contribute another source.

## Basis: source billing month
For separate statutory tax, read the billing period only from the exact posted primary internet outbound transfer selected export bundle; the assessment's own recorded period is not the source of the billing month.

## Basis Q&A
| Separate statutory tax basis | Consequence for this action |
| --- | --- |
| Separate statutory tax: Read the billing period only from the exact posted primary internet outbound transfer selected export bundle | the assessment's own recorded period is not the source of the billing month. |
